expo.name: 333 Lives
expo.description:
333 Lives is your personal legacy and life management app — built for the people who want to live intentionally, remember everything, and leave something meaningful behind.

Set daily intentions, build unbreakable habits, and track your streaks. Capture life events, record voice memos, and build a rich memory library organized by the people and moments that matter most. Write your story — chapter by chapter — so the ones you love can read it one day.

Stay connected to family and friends through the Pulse feed, celebrate milestones together, and never forget a birthday or anniversary. Manage your digital legacy with the Estate Vault: store your final letter, will, insurance details, medical directives, and trusted contacts — all in one secure place.

This is not just another productivity app. 333 Lives is the space where your everyday actions become your life's story.
